title: What is Kaizen?
alts: Kaizen Dashboard in Table view with search, Filters, Group By, Saved Views, the Table, List and Gantt switch, Export Kaizen, and the ID, Title, Lead Pillar, Slippage, Days to close, Days Delayed and State columns
leads: On the Kaizen Dashboard, the Table, List and Gantt buttons switch the view, and Export Kaizen downloads the list.

title: About the Kaizen process after creation
alts: Kaizen detail view with the Attach toolbar, Advance To, the P D C A phase tabs, the Add Section bar, phase sections and drag and drop box on the left, and the details panel on the right
leads: An open Kaizen shows its toolbar, phases and sections on the left, and its details on the right.

title: Edit information in a Kaizen
alts: Kaizen details panel with ID, status, Module, Project Type, Methodology, Workflow, Loss Type, Project Phase, Saving Status, Facility, Labels, Score and the project team fields
Kaizen implementation field with the Attach button and toolbar, phase tabs, Add Section bar, phase sections, Linked Docs and the drag and drop box

title: About Kaizen section types
alts: Add Section bar with Problem Description, Action Plan, MTTR, Description Of Repairs, Root Cause Analysis and & More
leads: Each phase has an Add Section bar with quick options for common sections. The rest are under & More.

title: Manage action plans, timelines and delays in a Kaizen
alts: Add Section bar with Problem Description, Action Plan, MTTR, Description Of Repairs, Root Cause Analysis and & More
Kaizen Dashboard toolbar with the Table, List and Gantt view switch next to Export Kaizen
corrections: In a Kaizen, click More → Action Plan.
In a Kaizen, click Action Plan in the Add Section bar, or find it under & More.

title: About the Action Plan section in Kaizen
alts: Add Section bar with Action Plan as a quick option, and & More for other sections

title: What is Best Practice?
alts: Best Practice dashboard with search, Filters, Group By, Saved Views, the Table, List and Gantt switch, Export Best Practices, and the ID, Title, Lead Pillar, Slippage, Days to close, Days Delayed and State columns
leads: The Best Practice dashboard lists the Best Practices in your facility.

title: What is Cost Management?
alts: Cost Management dashboard totals: Projected Saving, Closed Project Saving, Carry Over, Slippage and Variance, with Search, Filters and the Hard Savings Project and All Savings Projects tabs
leads: The totals at the top of the Cost Management dashboard show Projected Saving, Closed Project Saving, Carry Over, Slippage and Variance.

title: About the Floor Plan in F-Tag
alts: F-Tag Floor Plan with floor plan tabs, Average days to close, Open and Overdue tiles, zoom controls and a facility layout with colored areas and tag pins
leads: Each floor plan has its own tab. Count tiles such as Open and Overdue sit above the layout, with zoom controls at its top left.

title: About F-Tag statuses
alts: F-Tag Kanban Board with Overdue, Open and Pending Verification columns and tag cards
leads: On the Kanban Board, each status is a column with a count of the tags it holds.

title: What is LMS?
alts: LMS Dashboard with In Progress, Courses Completed and Courses Hours tiles and Your Courses with In Progress and Not Started tabs
leads: The LMS Dashboard shows your In Progress, Courses Completed and Courses Hours counts, then Your Courses.

title: About teams, skills, roles and procedures in the Skill Matrix
alts: Skill Matrix All Teams page with Total Teams, Pillar Teams, Expansion Teams and Other Teams counts and the teams table

title: Create a dashboard in Lean Studio
alts: Lean Studio dashboard list with All, Grid and Free Flow tabs, Search dashboards box and the Create Dashboard button at the top right
corrections: Open Lean Studio and click to create a new dashboard.
Open Lean Studio and click + Create Dashboard at the top right.

title: About AI drafts, drafts and published templates
alts: Lean Creator templates page with the AI Drafts row, Export Template, Create with AI and Create Template buttons
leads: AI drafts are listed in the AI Drafts row at the top of the Lean Creator templates page, above Create with AI and Create Template.

title: Create an SOP from a video
alts: Lean Creator templates page with the Create with AI button next to Create Template
